ambient_events: The cinder crust crunches under you and, somewhere, exhales a curl of heat.
A patch of the flat glows dull orange for a moment and then thinks better of it.
description: A flat of grey cinder that crunches underfoot like frozen ground, except it is not frozen — it is the cooled skin over heat that never fully left. In places the crust gives, and glows.
name: Cinder Flat
